digest.headline: Congressional Legislative Update for the Week of October 19, 2026

items.label: H.R. 2481
items.line: H.R. 2481, the Romance Scam Prevention Act, became law on October 20, 2026.
items.title: Romance Scam Prevention Act

items.label: H.R. 7022
items.line: H.R. 7022, the Mystic Alerts Act, was signed by the President on October 22, 2026.
items.title: Mystic Alerts Act

digest.overview: During the week of October 19, 2026 to October 26, 2026, Congress saw a total of 69 bills introduced. Across the same period, 8 bills became law. No tracked bills passed a chamber during this timeframe.
